boards.title: Your First Weekend at Maine Maritime Academy, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented between Maine Maritime Academy’s main and waterfront campuses in Castine.

cards.title: Start at the Training Ship State of Maine
cards.subtitle: Waterfront Campus • arrival and orientation
cards.notes: Begin with a waterfront landmark: view the Training Ship State of Maine from the public campus setting and use it to orient yourself to the academy’s maritime focus.
cards.short_summary: A named waterfront landmark for setting the tone of your first campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime Academy’s campus map identifies the Training Ship State of Maine on the Waterfront Campus.
cards.access_notes: Use the campus map to locate it; do not assume ship access or tours without a current Academy notice.

cards.title: Spot the Schooner Bowdoin
cards.subtitle: Waterfront Campus • ship-side stroll
cards.notes: Continue along the waterfront and identify the Schooner Bowdoin on the map. Keep this as a viewing stop unless the Academy posts a specific public program.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed schooner makes a concrete next stop by the waterfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime Academy’s campus map lists the Schooner Bowdoin on the Waterfront Campus.
cards.access_notes: Treat this as an exterior orientation stop; vessel access depends on Academy programming and authorization.

cards.title: Find the Tug Pentagoet
cards.subtitle: Waterfront Campus • map-reading pause
cards.notes: Use the waterfront portion of the campus map to find the Tug Pentagoet, then pause to compare the vessel locations with the surrounding Castine harbor.
cards.short_summary: A simple map-reading stop centered on MMA’s named tugboat.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime Academy’s campus map lists the Tug Pentagoet on the Waterfront Campus.
cards.access_notes: Locate it from public campus areas; do not board or enter waterfront work areas without permission.

cards.title: Connect the waterfront to Payson Hall
cards.subtitle: Waterfront Campus • academic waypoint
cards.notes: Walk the waterfront campus route toward Payson Hall and note how the map places classrooms and faculty offices near the Academy’s working-vessel area.
cards.short_summary: A named academic building that links the vessel area to campus learning spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime Academy’s campus map identifies Payson Hall as containing classrooms, labs, and faculty offices.
cards.access_notes: Exterior wayfinding is suitable; entry and room access follow Academy building policies.

cards.title: Locate the Harold Alfond Student Center
cards.subtitle: Main Campus • campus-services reset
cards.notes: Head uphill to the Harold Alfond Student Center and use the map to identify its dining, conference-room, staff-office, and classroom functions for later planning.
cards.short_summary: A central service stop that helps a newcomer understand where several campus functions are based.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime Academy’s campus map identifies the Harold Alfond Student Center as housing dining, conference rooms, staff offices, and classrooms.
cards.access_notes: Dining and room availability vary; check Academy information before relying on a particular service or event.

cards.title: Pin Nutting Memorial Library for later
cards.subtitle: Platz Hall • quiet-campus waypoint
cards.notes: Find Platz Hall and save Nutting Memorial Library as a calm return point. Use the Academy map first, then confirm current library access before planning a study visit.
cards.short_summary: A named library stop for future study planning rather than an assumed drop-in session.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime Academy’s campus map identifies Nutting Memorial Library in Platz Hall.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current access and hours directly with the Academy before entering or planning a study stop.

cards.title: Mark Delano Auditorium
cards.subtitle: Main Campus • events waypoint
cards.notes: Pass Delano Auditorium on your main-campus loop and make a note of its location. Check the Academy calendar later for any student-accessible program rather than assuming one.
cards.short_summary: An easy-to-find campus venue to remember when looking for future events.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime Academy’s campus map lists Delano Auditorium on the Main Campus.
cards.access_notes: Event entry and schedules are program-specific; consult current Academy announcements.

cards.title: Finish the campus loop at Ritchie Field
cards.subtitle: Main Campus • outdoor orientation stop
cards.notes: Walk to Ritchie Field to complete the main-campus loop, then use it as a reference point for navigating between academic buildings, residences, and athletic areas.
cards.short_summary: A named field that works as a practical landmark while learning the campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime Academy’s campus map lists Ritchie Field on the Main Campus.
cards.access_notes: Field use may be reserved for athletics or events; use surrounding paths and observe posted restrictions.

cards.entity_name: Oakey Logan Alexander Physical Education Center
cards.title: Locate the Physical Education Center
cards.subtitle: Main Campus • recreation-planning stop
cards.notes: Find the Oakey Logan Alexander Physical Education Center on the map, then check current Academy guidance before planning any fitness, cardio-room, or pool use.
cards.short_summary: A named recreation facility to save for a later, policy-checked visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime Academy’s campus map lists the Oakey Logan Alexander Physical Education Center, and its campus-resources page describes the Academy’s fitness and pool facilities.
cards.access_notes: The Academy says facility hours can change and local residents require active memberships; confirm current student access and hours.

cards.title: Take a daylight Main Street walk
cards.subtitle: Castine • town wrap-up
cards.notes: End with a daylight walk on Castine’s Main Street, noticing the village setting around campus. The Academy identifies a bakery, bookstore, general store, galleries, and inns there.
cards.short_summary: A town-scale wrap-up that connects the campus to Castine’s walkable village center.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime Academy’s visitor page says Castine’s main street has a bakery, bank, bookstore, general store, art galleries, and two inns.
cards.access_notes: Business access, purchases, and hours vary; this card is a daylight walking orientation activity, not a recommendation to buy anything.
